current_date: October 2025 (document text: 'Local List of Validation Requirements (LLVR), October 2025'); BNG section updated by web page note effective 6 August 2026
current_evidence: Derby's Planning applications page (modified 21 Oct 2026) links this LLVR as the current list. The document text is dated October 2025.

issues.detail: The List date comes from PDF metadata (CreationDate). The month matches the document text (October 2025), but the Date basis should cite the text, not the file metadata.
issues.evidence: Cover: 'Local List of Validation Requirements (LLVR) October 2025'

issues.detail: The planning page has an 'Updated Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) guidance' section. It says BNG legislation changes took effect on 6 August 2026 and that this text updates the LLVR. Grokbot's BNG requirement does not reflect this update.
issues.evidence: Planning applications page: 'updates what is in the Local List of Validation Requirements'

issues.detail: Several local requirements were not captured at all. Aerodrome Safeguarding Assessment (development in aerodrome safeguarding areas affecting protected surfaces, lighting, solar, reflections or bird hazard; CDLPR E30). Climate Change Statement and Assessment Tool (Full and Reserved Matters, using the Derbyshire tool). Planning Statement (Full and Outline). Regeneration Statement (Full and Outline). Residential commencement and delivery information (any application including residential development). Statement of Community Involvement (Full and Outline; it appears only as a URL fragment). Open Space Assessment (Full and Outline affecting public open space). Transport Assessment (Full and Outline major development; only the Travel Plan was captured). Great Crested Newts survey (any application affecting GCN). Retail/leisure Impact Assessment (above 1,000 sqm outside the centre hierarchy).
issues.evidence: LLVR table entries: 'Climate Change Statement and Assessment Tool - Full and Reserved Matters applications'; 'Residential commencement and delivery information'; 'Aerodrome Safeguarding Assessment'

issues.detail: Householder is marked 'No specific local requirements', but the LLVR applies several items to householder or domestic work. Flood Risk Assessment applies to 'Full and Outline applications, (including householder development)' in Flood Zones 2/3 or within 20m of a watercourse. Air Source Heat Pumps / Wind Turbines need an MCS-020 noise assessment for 'any proposals for domestic installations'. Arboricultural Impact Assessment applies to 'any application' affecting trees, Archaeological Assessment is city-wide, and Photographs apply to 'any application'.
issues.evidence: FRA: 'Full and Outline applications, (including householder development)'

issues.detail: About 23 rows are tagged 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning', even though the LLVR names the application types for almost every item. As a result, many Full-and-Outline items appear only under Full: Land Contamination, Lighting, Noise, Parking and Access, Structural Survey, Draft Travel Plan, Ventilation/Extraction and FRA. Others appear only under Outline and are missing from Full: Affordable Housing, Air Quality, Photographs, Planning Obligations and Heritage Statement. Reserved matters items are also incomplete: Biodiversity & Geological Survey and the Climate Change Statement are missing. The Site Waste Management Plan is missing from Full.
issues.evidence: e.g. Land Contamination: 'Full and Outline applications including Changes of Use'; Biodiversity survey: 'Full, Outline and Reserved Matters applications'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are garbled or misstate the threshold. Affordable Housing has a table header fragment and omits the '15 or more units' threshold. Health Impact Assessment has archaeology text, but the source requires it only for 'all planning applications requiring an EIA'. The Retail/Town Centre trigger is header text and omits the 1,000 sqm impact threshold. Arboricultural reads only 'and experienced arboriculturist.'. BNG reads 'submit your BNG Metric as a xlsx file' and omits the exemptions (householder, de minimis, self-build, etc.). Noise Impact cites only the MCS-020 heat-pump note, not the general noise-sensitive trigger. Archaeology is a jumbled run of words.
issues.evidence: Affordable Housing Statement: 'Full and Outline applications' where 15 or more units proposed; HIA: 'All planning applications requiring an EIA.'

issues.detail: 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' is the wrong name. The LLVR item is a 'Site Waste Management Plan' for major industrial or commercial development in sensitive locations, not bin storage details.
issues.evidence: LLVR: 'Site Waste Management Plan - Full, outline and reserved matters applications.'

issues.detail: 'Employment / Economic Statement' and 'Marketing / vacancy evidence (loss of use)' are the same LLVR item (Loss of Employment Land Statement) with the same garbled trigger text, which includes lighting wording. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is part of the Heritage Statement guidance, not a separate local item, and it sits under Full planning.
issues.evidence: LLVR: 'Loss of Employment Land Statement - All proposals resulting in the loss of existing employment land or buildings.'

issues.detail: Some tab items are fragments, not requirements. 'Derby City Council Statement of Community involvement can be found at: ocaldevelopmentframework/Revised_SCI_Adopted_July_%202017.pdf Structural Survey Full and Outline applications.' is a broken URL run into the next row. 'This must be up Matter planning to date...' is garbled. The Environmental Statement row's trigger 'This information might form part of an Environmental Statement' is boilerplate, not the EIA Schedule 1/2 trigger.
issues.evidence: Tab item text under 'Submission rules' and 'Drawing / document standards'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Derby LLVR (October 2025). However, its capture misses about 10 local requirements (climate change tool, residential delivery info, aerodrome safeguarding, GCN and others) and ignores the application types stated in the LLVR by putting most items under Full planning only. It also wrongly says householder has no local requirements and has many garbled triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
